result.instructions: Tools for Zenduty, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on call for our checkout team right now?"; "Show me all open incidents for the payments service."; "Acknowledge the incident that is still triggered on the API service.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zenduty data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenduty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenduty_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenduty_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zenduty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenduty_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams in the Zenduty account with their unique_id, name and owner. Start here to get a team_id for the other tools. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services of a team: name, status (0 disabled, 1 active, 2 warning, 3 critical, 4 under maintenance), escalation policy and unique_id. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/services/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_escalation_policies
tools.title: List escalation policies
tools.description: List the escalation policies of a team: name, rules and repeat policy. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/escalation_policies/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_schedules
tools.title: List on-call schedules
tools.description: List the on-call schedules of a team with their layers, overrides and time zone. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/schedules/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the members of a team with their username and role. Use the username for assigned_to in the incident tools. Zenduty API: GET /api/account/teams/{team_id}/members/.

tools.name: zenduty_get_oncall
tools.title: Who is on call
tools.description: Show who is on call right now, per escalation policy of a team (name, oncalls, unique_id). Zenduty API: GET /api/v2/account/teams/{team_id}/oncall/.

tools.name: zenduty_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents with filters. status: -1 open (triggered and acknowledged), 0 all, 1 triggered, 2 acknowledged, 3 resolved. from_date and to_date take YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. all_teams: 1 for all teams, 0 for the teams of the API key's user. Results are paginated by page. Zenduty API: POST /api/incidents/filter/ (a read; the filter is sent in the body).

all_teams.description: 1 = all teams, 0 = teams of the key's user (default 1).

from_date.description: Incidents created on or after this value: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

to_date.description: Incidents created on or before this value: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

user_ids.description: Usernames the incidents are assigned to.

tools.name: zenduty_get_incident
tools.title: Get an incident
tools.description: Get one incident by incident_number: title, summary, status, urgency, service, assigned_to, creation and resolution dates. Zenduty API: GET /api/incidents/{incident_number}/.

incident_number.description: Incident number, the integer shown as incident_number (from zenduty_list_incidents).

tools.name: zenduty_list_incident_notes
tools.title: List incident notes
tools.description: List the notes of an incident (note text, author, time). Zenduty API: GET /api/incidents/{incident_number}/note/.

incident_number.description: Incident number, the integer shown as incident_number (from zenduty_list_incidents).

tools.name: zenduty_list_incident_alerts
tools.title: List incident alerts
tools.description: List the alerts that were grouped into an incident: message, summary, alert type and time. Zenduty API: GET /api/incidents/{incident_number}/alerts/.

incident_number.description: Incident number, the integer shown as incident_number (from zenduty_list_incidents).

tools.name: zenduty_list_incident_responders
tools.title: List incident responders
tools.description: List the responders added to an incident, with their response status (1 accepted, 2 declined, 3 pending). Zenduty API: GET /api/v2/incidents/{incident_number}/responders/.

incident_number.description: Incident number, the integer shown as incident_number (from zenduty_list_incidents).

tools.name: zenduty_create_incident
tools.title: Create an incident
tools.description: Create an incident on a service. This pages the service's on-call people, so confirm first. Zenduty API: POST /api/incidents/.

tools.name: zenduty_update_incident
tools.title: Update an incident
tools.description: Change an incident: status (1 triggered, 2 acknowledged, 3 resolved), urgency (0 low, 1 high), title, summary, assignee or policy. Fields you do not pass stay unchanged. Zenduty API: PATCH /api/incidents/{incident_number}/ (the live route takes the integer incident_number, not the unique_id).

incident_number.description: Incident number, the integer shown as incident_number (from zenduty_list_incidents).

tools.name: zenduty_add_incident_note
tools.title: Add a note to an incident
tools.description: Add a note to an incident timeline. Each call adds a new note, so a repeated call adds a duplicate. Zenduty API: POST /api/incidents/{incident_number}/note/.

incident_number.description: Incident number, the integer shown as incident_number (from zenduty_list_incidents).

annotations.title: Add a note to an incident

prompts.name: review_open_incidents_and_their_alerts
prompts.title: Review open incidents and their alerts
prompts.description: List open incidents, filtered by status or date. Open one incident and read the alerts grouped into it.

prompts.name: read_incident_notes_and_responders
prompts.title: Read incident notes and responders
prompts.description: Read the notes added to an incident. Check which responders accepted, declined or have not answered yet.

prompts.title: Acknowledge, resolve or reassign an incident
prompts.description: Read the incident first. Change its status, urgency or assignee. Fields you do not pass stay unchanged.

prompts.title: Create an incident and record notes
prompts.description: Create an incident on a service. This pages the on-call people. Add a note to the incident timeline.
